limitations.note: The rewrite fixes the default waveform but changes pulse widths for parameter overrides: with div_e=16, it drives the output high for eight input cycles instead of the six produced by the minimal fix.
The default check could catch the original bug, but the override check expected the rewrite’s new pulse width, so it passed without detecting the change in parameterized behavior.
